values.description: Origin plus API_PREFIX and the version segment. Request paths start after it.

Sent as Origin on every request. Must appear in the API CORS_ORIGINS, which backs both CORS and the CSRF Origin check — an origin missing there fails every unsafe request with csrf-check-failed rather than with a CORS error.
The API SESSION_COOKIE_NAME. Must keep the __Host- prefix; the API refuses to start without it.
The API CSRF_COOKIE_NAME. Must NOT carry the __Host- prefix — the client has to be able to read it.
Set to false to stop the pre-request script signing in on demand, leaving the session entirely under the control of the Sign in request.
The account the collection signs in as. Fill in as a CURRENT value.
Fill in as a CURRENT value only. Never type a password into an initial value: initial values are what an export writes to disk.
The replacement used by Change password and Confirm password reset. Current value only.
Captured from Set-Cookie by the sign-in script. Leave empty — it is written for you, and a value here is a live credential.
ISO timestamp derived from the session cookie Max-Age. An expired token is treated as absent, so the next request signs in again.
Captured from the CSRF cookie. Written for you; leave empty.
The signed-in account, captured on sign-in.
The organisation the tenancy folders act on. Captured by Create organisation, or by List organisations when empty.
Body value for Create organisation.
Globally unique: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Change it before recreating, or the answer is 409 conflict.
A member other than the caller, captured by List members. The role and grant requests act on this id.
Captured by List workspaces when empty.
Captured by List projects when empty.
Captured by List signed-in devices.
Captured by Invite a member.
The address Invite a member sends to. An address with no account is fine — invitations never read the users table.
From the verification link the API logs. Single use, 24 hours by default.
From the password reset link the API logs. Single use, 30 minutes by default.
From the invitation link the API logs. Single use, one week by default.
A six-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code. Valid for one 30-second step — set it immediately before sending.
The first of the ten codes Confirm TOTP enrolment returned. One use each.
Either github or google.
Authorization code, for replaying a provider callback.
The state that came back with it.
Used by the disabled Idempotency-Key headers. A UUID is the recommended value; keep it stable across the retry you want replayed.
Only needed when the API runs with TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY set.
